title: Black Trump
author: George R. R. Martin
note: conf=0.96; Filename/metadata identification is correct and now filled in. Black Trump (Bantam, 1995) is Volume 15 of the Wild Cards shared-universe series edited by George R. R. Martin. It is a mosaic novel with stories by Stephen Leigh, George R. R. Martin, Sage Walker, John J. Miller and Victor Milan; Martin is credited as editor, but catalogs and the EPUB metadata list him as author, which I have retained. It forms the third book of the informal "Card Sharks Triad" (#13 Card Sharks, #14 Marked Cards, #15 Black Trump), but that triad is a grouping within the single numbered Wild Cards series rather than a separately published/numbered series, so Wild Cards #15 is given. Note: the 2025 Bantam reprint retitled the book "Showdown" (released 18 March 2025); the canonical/original title of this file is Black Trump. No ISBN in the file; original 1995 mass-market edition.
